sections.identityDescription: What to call this and what it’s about.

whereDescription.consumerClub: Online or in person. In-person clubs run at a specific site.
whereDescription.municipalityClub: Paid for by a specific municipality. Online clubs pick the municipality directly; in-person clubs pick a site within it.
whereDescription.camp: Online or in person. In-person camps run at a specific site.
whereDescription.event: Online or in person. In-person events run at a specific site.

whenDescription.consumerClub: One day per week, one time. Leave the end date blank for an ongoing club.
whenDescription.municipalityClub: One day per week, one time. Runs between the start and end dates.
whenDescription.camp: Multiple days per week, each with its own start time and duration.
whenDescription.event: A single date and start time.

billingDescription.consumerClub: Parents pay per session their child attends. Billing happens automatically each week.
billingDescription.municipalityClub: School of Gaming invoices the municipality directly. Parents register their child for free, up to the seat limit.
billingDescription.camp: Camps can be free (with or without a seat limit) or paid upfront. A paid camp is charged in full at signup, refundable up to a cutoff.
billingDescription.event: Events can be free (with or without a seat limit) or paid upfront.

sections.registrationDescription: Pick when parents can start signing up.
sections.consentsDescription: What a parent agrees to, and what they are asked, on the way through signup. Required documents must be accepted before a seat can be taken; the photo question and the marketing question may both be declined.
sections.visibilityDescription: Decides where this product is advertised, not who may buy it. Sign-ups are opened and closed by the registration date, the seat limit and the product's status — never by this setting.

fees.sectionDescription: What we pay the Gedus each session, and — for municipality clubs — what the municipality pays us. These are internal figures, separate from what parents pay above.
fees.primaryGeduHint: Paid to the lead Gedu per session. Choose Unknown if you’ll set it later, or Volunteer if they run it for free.
fees.assistantGeduHint: Paid to an assistant Gedu per session. Choose None if there’s no assistant.
fees.municipalityHint: What the municipality pays us per session. Choose Unknown if you’ll set it later.

registrationModes.label: When does registration open?
registrationModes.immediatelyDescription: Parents can sign up the moment this product becomes visible.
registrationModes.scheduledDescription: Parents see a countdown until then. Useful for ticket-drop style launches.

voiceRoomModes.label: How do families join?
voiceRoomModes.sogverseDescription: A voice room is set up automatically and opens for each session.
voiceRoomModes.externalDescription: Families join a meeting you host on another service. For audiences larger than a Sogverse room holds (50 people).
voiceRoomModes.noneDescription: Families are shown the join instructions you write for each language instead.

endDateModes.ongoingDescription: The club runs indefinitely until you decide to wind it down.
endDateModes.datedDescription: The club runs until a specific date, then completes automatically.

lynxEducate.label: Photos and videos (Lynx Educate)
lynxEducate.description: Ticking this adds an optional question to this product’s signup: parents are asked whether photos and videos of their child may be taken and used by School of Gaming, Lynx Educate and Roblox. They may decline, and the seat is unaffected. Asked per child, and re-asked on every enrolment.

lynxEducate.label: Lynx Educate
lynxEducate.description: Ticking this adds an optional question to this product’s signup: parents are asked whether to share their email address with Lynx Educate. They may decline, and the seat is unaffected.

hints.shortDescription: A one-line teaser shown on browse cards, listings, and the top of the detail page.
hints.longDescription: Optional. The full pitch, shown only on the product’s detail page. Headings, lists, emphasis and links are all available.
hints.voiceJoinInstructionsHint: How families join the sessions, written for this language. Public: anyone can read it, including visitors who are not signed in.
hints.topicHint: What this product is about. Families see it as the Topic filter in the shop and on the product page’s About card.
hints.materialUrlHint: Optional. For Gedus only — families never see this.
hints.requiresGamerCreationsHint: For products a contract requires it of. The final session keeps a needs-attention mark until every gamer in the group has a creation recorded. Families see nothing different.
hints.seatAudienceHint: Pick at least one. Both means a product a parent and their gamer take part in together — the shop labels it “For families”.
hints.forGamersHint: A parent signs their gamer up and the gamer takes the seat. Needs an age range.
hints.forParentsHint: A parent takes a seat for themselves and attends it. No age range — age describes children, not adults.
hints.tagHint: Optional. Families see it as a badge on the shop card and product page. It says who the sessions were built for, not who may take a seat.
hints.regionLockHint: Only families in the chosen country can sign up. Their location is the one they told us themselves, so this is a signpost in the shop rather than a hard block — and anyone already enrolled keeps their place if they move.
hints.spokenLanguageHint: The main language spoken in the sessions.
hints.externalVoiceUrlHint: Public: anyone can read this link, including visitors who are not signed in.
hints.municipalityHint: Municipality clubs are always tied to a specific Finnish municipality — the one paying for it. Parents from that municipality will see it when they browse.
hints.eventSingleDay: Events happen on a single date.
hints.timezoneEntry: Session times below are entered in this timezone. Parents see them converted to their own automatically.
hints.timezoneChangeMoves: Session times below are entered in this timezone. Changing it moves every upcoming session to the same clock time in the new zone, while sessions that already have a report or attendance recorded keep the times they were held at.
hints.timezoneIs: Times are in {timezone}. Parents see them converted to their local timezone automatically.
hints.billingHint: Free products default to a seat limit; paid ones start unlimited.
hints.freeDetail: No charge. Anyone can join with one click.
hints.paidByMunicipality: No customer billing inside this system. School of Gaming invoices the municipality directly.
hints.pricingMonthly: Charged every month while the subscription is active. Cancel anytime.
hints.pricingUpfront: Charged once at signup. Same total no matter the duration.
hints.seatHintWaitlist: When full, new signups go to the waitlist.
hints.seatHintNoWaitlist: When full, new signups are refused.
hints.visibleHint: Unchecked, the product appears on no public page — but anyone with the direct link can still open it and buy a place. That is what makes it right for unannounced, invite-only or campaign products. It is not a way to stop sign-ups, and it never affects parents and gamers already taking part.
hints.seatLimitHint: Cap the number of participants, or run with no limit.
hints.startDateBillingAnchor: The date the club starts, and the date families are first charged. Changing it later does not move the first charge for anyone who has already signed up — correct those subscriptions in Stripe.
hints.startNotSessionDay: No session falls on this date. The first session is {date}.
hints.endNotSessionDay: No session falls on this date. The last session is {date}.

promoteUnpaid.title: This seat needs a subscription
promoteUnpaid.description: {name} is on the waitlist without a subscription, and a seat on this club is billed every month. Seating them now would enroll them for free.
promoteUnpaid.nextStep: Ask the family to take the seat themselves: while a seat is open the club shows as available in the shop, so they can leave the waitlist from their My SOG card and check out — which is what sets the subscription up.

demoteSubscribed.title: The subscription is still live
demoteSubscribed.description: Moving {name} to the waitlist would leave a live subscription behind, still billing the family for a seat they no longer hold.
demoteSubscribed.nextStep: The family opens the billing card on their My SOG page, which takes them to Stripe's secure billing portal to cancel. Once the subscription ends, the seat is released.

removeSubscribed.title: The subscription is still live
removeSubscribed.description: Removing {name} would leave the family's subscription billing for a seat that no longer exists.
removeSubscribed.nextStep: The family opens the billing card on their My SOG page, which takes them to Stripe's secure billing portal to cancel. Once the subscription ends, the seat is released.

switchClub.title: Switch club
switchClub.description: Move {name} to another club. Nothing changes for the family today: the same card is charged on the same date, and from then on they pay the new club's price.

picker.empty: There is no other club to switch to. A target has to be a club billed monthly that has not finished.

prices.error: The price check did not come back. Pick the club again to retry.

refusals.latestInvoiceNotPaid: The family's latest invoice is not paid, so there is no paid time to move. Sort this out in Stripe first.
refusals.subscriptionNotSingleItem: The subscription carries more than one item, so there is no single price to swap. Sort this out in Stripe first.
refusals.noTargetPriceInCurrency: This club has no price in the currency the subscription bills in. Clubs are priced in euros, so a subscription Stripe created in another currency cannot be switched here — sort this out in Stripe first.
refusals.participationNotActive: This seat is not active, so there is nothing to move.
refusals.noLiveSubscription: No live subscription stands behind this seat, so this is not the tool for it: remove the seat and enroll the gamer on the other club instead.
refusals.targetNotPaidSubscriptionClub: That product is not a club billed monthly, so a subscription cannot follow the seat onto it.
refusals.sameProduct: That is the club the gamer is already on.
refusals.alreadyOnTarget: This gamer already holds a place on that club.

commit.stripeUpdated: The subscription is already on the new club's price, but the seat did not move. Press Switch club again to finish — pressing again does not charge the family twice.
commit.stripeUpdatedStuck: The subscription is already on the new club's price even though the seat could not move, so the family is billed for a club the gamer holds no place on. Sort this out in Stripe first.
commit.failed: The switch did not complete. Press Switch club again — a repeated press replays the same request, so it never charges the family twice.
